$schema_note: Committed fallback for /live/uptime.json — served only until the first Worker cron run writes the live doc to KV. Rolling uptime history for every probed target (announced services + the marketplace's own self:* surfaces), recomputable from the raw runs[] it carries. See the live route.
formula: uptime_pct = alive / (alive + unreachable); unprobeable observations (unverified-tor-only, unroutable) are excluded from the denominator
how_to_check: Recompute any stat from runs[] — each run is {at, targets: {key: status}}. This fallback predates the first run, so runs is empty.
